news.notes: The Canucks did not hold a morning skate after a 6-3 win at the Vegas Golden Knights on Sunday. ... Tolopilo is likely to play after being recalled from Abbotsford of the American Hockey League on Sunday. ... Marino skated in a full-contact jersey Monday, but the defenseman is unlikely to play. He's missed the past 12 games. ... Cooley skated in a noncontact jersey, but the forward likely will miss his fourth straight game. ... Duda left the morning skate early after blocking a shot and did not return. Mammoth coach Andre Tourigny said the defenseman will be a game-time decision.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.comment: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.
